I'm a Senior Physiotherapist with 20 years experience in hospital, clinical and fitness centres.  

Currently Treating: 
 Sport Injury, Stroke Patients, Geriatric Patients, Disc Prolapse & Sciatic Patients, Also help patients with Obesity management. 

Types of Treatments: 
 Dry Needling, Acuputure, Kinesiology Taping ,Manual Therapy - Chiropractic Adjustment, Deep Tissue Stimulation
 Rehabilitation & Post Natal Program

I treat my patients with professional ethics and avoid giving false hopes or promise. I treat patients with utmost transparency. 

To get in touch with me you can email or call me. 
Email: andrewphysiofit@gmail.com
Contact:  99414 12435
